sloka: यावत्सुरैश्च विप्रैश्च न विरुध्येर्महासुर ।तावच्छूलं तवेदं स्यादन्यथा नाशमेप्यति ।। ७.६१.९ ॥
transliteration: yāvatsuraiśca vipraiśca na virudhyermahāsura ।tāvacchūlaṁ tavedaṁ syādanyathā nāśamepyati ।। 7.61.9 ॥

translations.english: O great Asura, as long as you do not contend with gods and Brahmins, this spear shall remain yours; otherwise, it will meet its destruction.
